sn33.55:1.2: Viññāṇe kho Vaccha apaccakkhakammā viññāṇasamudaye apaccakkhakammā viññāṇanirodhe apaccakkhakammā viññāṇanirodhagāminiyā paṭipadāya apaccakkhakammā ||
sn33.55:1.3: evam imāni anekavihitāni diṭṭhigatāni loke upajjanti
sn33.55:1.4: Sassato loko ti vā Asassato loko ti vā || pe || ||
sn33.55:1.5: Neva hoti na na hoti tathāgato param maraṇā ti vā ti || || 5
sn33.55:1.6: Ayaṃ kho Vaccha hetu ayam paccayo yānimāni anekavihitāni diṭṭhigatāni loke uppajjanti || ||
